name: Volume Six
title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero #6
desc: NEW THREATS, NEW JOES! The world of G.I. JOE gets even bigger when Duke, Snake-Eyes, Scarlett, and Stalker discover a new threat that spans the entire globe...and beyond! As new members are added to their ranks to combat a force like none they’ve faced before, Cobra Commander’s new-look Cobra readies their next strike! Legendary series writer Larry Hama is joined by ANDREW KRAHNKE, PAUL PELLETIER and TONY KORDOS to deliver the next exciting volume of this iconic comic book series! Collects G.I. JOE: A REAL AMERICAN HERO #326-330.
